Coinbase wins final OCC approval for national trust bank charter

Coinbase has received final approval from the U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency for its national trust bank charter, following conditional approval in April. The charter will support the company’s crypto custody, payments and potential stablecoin issuance or administration activities, but does not allow it to take ordinary deposits or make loans like a traditional commercial bank. — link

Binance Says Alleged 335M-User Data Leak Likely a Scam

@BinanceHelpDesk said it is investigating claims that ShinyHunters stole data on 335 million users and demanded $900,000, but has found no evidence that its systems, KYC data, account credentials or wallet private keys were compromised.
